excluded_lineages: its product namespace, per-turn execution scope and one-time migration decisions
PR 253, fleet migration, secret handling, target review and acceptance descendants

decisions.summary: Choose the terminal workspace configuration directory for generic kernel, PA and Coding CLI.

accepted_outcomes: The generic SDK default remains .nano; PA explicitly selects .nanoassistant; Coding CLI explicitly selects .nanocode.
rejected_outcomes: Rename the generic kernel default to a product namespace.
Make PA and CLI share one hidden directory.

decisions.summary: Choose which PA workspace state moves under .nanoassistant and preserve readable chat history separately from transcript.

accepted_outcomes: PA sessions, memory, skills, cron, heartbeat, background outputs, policy and readable chat_history live under workspace/.nanoassistant; readable chat history remains a separate copy and does not replace session transcript.
rejected_outcomes: Leave PA chat_history at workspace root.
Conflate the readable copy with the authoritative transcript.

decisions.summary: Choose the global PA home and default Agent workspace layout while preserving external workspace roots.

accepted_outcomes: Global PA state lives at ~/.nanoassistant; managed default workspaces live at ~/.nanoassistant/workspaces/<agent-id>; explicitly external workspace roots stay where they are.
rejected_outcomes: Move every external workspace into the managed home.
Keep creating new defaults under the legacy directory.

decisions.summary: Choose whether migration is runtime compatibility or a one-time deployment operation.

accepted_outcomes: Migration is a documented, one-time, fail-closed deployment procedure; terminal runtime has no legacy fallback, automatic migration or ongoing sync.
rejected_outcomes: Dual-read old and new roots indefinitely.
Auto-migrate user files during normal startup.

decisions.summary: Choose how existing managed and external workspaces are treated during migration.

accepted_outcomes: Move old managed defaults and rewrite their stored roots; keep external workspace roots fixed and move only their workspace-relative PA runtime files into .nanoassistant.
rejected_outcomes: Classify every matching path string globally without node ownership.
Move the external repository itself.

decisions.summary: Choose how legacy .nano extensions and policy are seeded into each product directory.

accepted_outcomes: During the one-time migration, copy missing tools, hooks, skills and policy into the product directory without overwriting existing destinations; retain the source and do not resync.
rejected_outcomes: Delete the legacy source after copying.
Overwrite product-specific files or keep a permanent mirror.

decisions.summary: Choose production JWT secret migration semantics.

accepted_outcomes: Validate the existing non-empty secret before shutdown, copy the same bytes to the new path with 0600, verify equality and fleet health, then remove the old source; never rotate or generate during migration.
rejected_outcomes: Stop IM before reading the old secret.
Overwrite a conflicting target.
Generate a replacement key.

decisions.summary: Avoid mutating repository .gitignore files while changing hidden product directories.

accepted_outcomes: Do not auto-edit .gitignore; document the new runtime directories and let repository owners choose ignore policy.
rejected_outcomes: Rewrite every workspace .gitignore during startup or migration.

decisions.summary: Create a product-neutral workspace layout abstraction and pass product-specific roots through the public SDK.

accepted_outcomes: Core owns pure layout vocabulary; platform loads product-root extensions; SDK exposes the necessary product inputs; PA and CLI remain SDK-only consumers.
rejected_outcomes: Hard-code .nanoassistant in core.
Let PA import agent.core or agent.platform.

decisions.summary: Make tools, hooks, auto-mode and policy use one immutable per-turn workspace execution scope.

accepted_outcomes: Each turn carries one scope containing repo root, extension registries, auto-mode config and policy overrides through HookContext and permission checks; concurrent workspaces remain isolated.
rejected_outcomes: Keep build-time shared extension state that can evaluate one Agent with another workspace's policy.
Fix ordinary tool lookup but leave auto-mode or bash policy global.

decisions.summary: Update IM's independently owned managed-default resolver and provenance without adding forbidden imports.

accepted_outcomes: IM independently recognizes the new managed-default layout and persists workspace_is_default while remaining separately deployed and independent of PA/agent imports.
rejected_outcomes: Change only Gateway and leave IM classifying the old default.
Import PA path helpers into IM.

decisions.summary: Produce complete canonical delta specs and a migration runbook with real cross-product verification.

accepted_outcomes: Deltas cover SDK, tools/hooks, PA routing/history, Gateway lifecycle/cron, IM Agents and CLI assembly without dropping canonical scenarios; the runbook verifies online nodes, heartbeat/cron RPC and real PA/CLI paths.
rejected_outcomes: Modify only code paths with no durable current-spec carriers.
Use PID existence as the only migration acceptance evidence.
